property_summary: For any target address and amount, calling sendMoney on the correct contract either forwards the funds successfully (call returns true) or reverts so the caller observes failure; the mutant swallows a failing call and thus can make sendMoney appear successful even when the external call would have failed (i.e., correct contract never silently ignores a failed external call, mutant can).
change_summary: Remove the revert-on-failure branch by performing the call but ignore the returned success value, allowing failures to be silently ignored (so state after call may differ).
